//cleanUrls: Deliberately off. cleanUrls is site-wide with no path scoping: it would also 308 /games/<id>/screen.html and controller.html to extensionless paths, and those URLs are load-bearing - iframes load them literally (public/session.js) and the Firestore catalog stores them as data (screenUrl/controllerUrl). The rewrites below give the six real pages extensionless URLs without touching anything under public/.

headers.//: headers match the *incoming* request path, before rewrites, so the rule above - which needs a literal .html - never fires for the extensionless URLs. Without this they would fall back to Vercel's default caching, which is the stale-ES-module trap: a browser holds one module while fetching a fresh one that imports it, and the mismatched pair fails to link.
